title: Antigravity
tagline: Gravity has turned upside down aboard the Helios-7 space station!
blurb: Gravity has turned upside down aboard the Helios-7 space station! Feather your down-thrust, brake hard and grab three power cores in every bay before the oxygen runs out. Ten sectors across three decks, sweeping lasers, sentry drones and an S, A, B or C rank for every bay.

review.verdict: Falling upwards has never been so much fun: a budget flier with plenty of lift, despite a couple of rough edges.

quote.text: Neat and honest, if a bit plain

credits.name: ZAK, PRU and GRIFF for INK & PAPER
